title: Help
subtitle: Frequently asked questions and Ciyou Eats support contact.

late.question: My order is late, what should I do?
late.answer: Check the order tracking: the status and courier position (if assigned) update there in real time.

editCancel.question: How do I change or cancel an order?
editCancel.answer: An order that has already been sent can no longer be changed from the app; contact the restaurant or support shortly after it's sent.

missingItem.question: An item is missing or different
missingItem.answer: From the relevant order's details, you can report the issue to support.

deleteAccount.question: How do I delete my account?
deleteAccount.answer: Contact support by email: your request will be handled per our privacy policy.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.description: Open a request: our team replies to you directly in the app.
